 1.  10份塔罗牌实体卡牌（对应56张普卡卡面+该游戏普通大金大闪互动卡卡面，材质：高级扑克纸）
2.  已报名但超额玩家可任选2张印签/唇印卡+2份印签照片袋

Steam库存背包收集到全套小阿卡那金卡(火焰)，截图报名兑换周边。
活动周边：
1. 10份塔罗牌实体卡牌（对应游戏56张普卡卡面+该游戏普通大金大闪互动卡卡面，材质：高级扑克纸）
2. 已报名但超额玩家可任选1张印签/唇印卡+2份印签照片袋

报名要求：
Steam库存背包收集到全套小阿卡那普卡(火焰)，截图报名兑换周边。
活动周边：
1. 10份塔罗牌实体卡牌（对应游戏56张普卡卡面+该游戏普通大金大闪互动卡卡面，材质：高级扑克纸）
2. 已报名但超额玩家可任选1张印签/唇印卡+1份印签照片袋

(3)报名链接：https://f.wps.cn/g/rSk4lQw3/

2.活动兑换周边：
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45280261/48e9b8e4aff1315272009bf4b8b539971c07ec07.png
【唇印色纸-印签】

notes.title: Major Update Notice - Added Mutant Flame Card
notes.content:
Respected Players of "Game of Fate",

The new version 0.1.0 has introduced the Mutant Flame Card. Please update your client to version 0.1.0 as soon as possible after the new version is released. We will launch an event on March 18th at 10:00 AM, during which you will have a chance to obtain the Mutant Flame Card.

If you continue to use an older version after the event starts, you may encounter errors when claiming chests, resulting in failure to receive them successfully.
Thank you for your understanding and support!

Friendly Reminder: Restarting Steam can quickly fetch the update.

Attachment: Probability table for obtaining the Mutant Flame Card is provided below.
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45280261/d580ca5546fe6aac1678fde1eb72e411eb6169c7.png

notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear “GameOfFate” Players,

We sincerely apologize for the unexpected issues in the newly released version 0.0.11, which caused abnormal visual effects with the Tarot card’s ripple art for some players. To ensure a smooth experience, we have urgently rolled back to the stable version 0.0.10.

We deeply regret any inconvenience this may have caused and appreciate your understanding and support.

Tip: Restart Steam to receive the update promptly.

notes.title: “Game of Fate” Set to Release on October 31, Launch Discount of 12% Off!
notes.content:
“Game of Fate” Official Version Set to Release on October 31, Launch Discount of 12% Off!

Hello everyone, greetings from the development team of “Game of Fate” and we extend our sincerest wishes! Thank you for your attention and support. The first-person interactive mystery work, “Game of Fate” will officially meet you on October 31st, 2024!
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44905249/84de785518eed3587f8c4e168b8ae594cdb0d5d9.jpg

We also encourage you to participate in the ongoing event to win the official game CDKEY!
